{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MC-009","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"title","page":1,"quote":"SHAFT"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D28","page":1,"quote":"-0.009"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D29","page":1,"quote":"-0.025"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D36","page":1,"quote":"-0.009"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D37","page":1,"quote":"-0.025"}],"comment":"The drawing is for a shaft with tight g6 tolerance sections (features F21 and F27), which require turning between centres, yet no centre holes are specified. Without defined centre holes the machinist has no datum to hold the part accurately, risking out-of-tolerance diameters; the designer should add centre hole callouts at both ends of the shaft."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add centre hole specifications (e.g., per ISO 6411) at both ends of the shaft."}]}
